component.name: SplitButton
component.description: Primary action button with dropdown menu for related secondary actions, with collision detection and nested menu support.

parts.label: dropdown toggle
parts.description: Caret segment that opens menu (Button component).

parts.label: menu item
parts.description: Individual action in menu (can have children for nested menu).

parts.label: nested submenu
parts.description: Second-level menu for items with children.

behavior.map: Primary action + dropdown for related actions. Collision detection repositions menu if insufficient viewport space (top/bottom, start/end). Focus management with Arrow keys, Tab (trapped), Home, End, Escape. Nested menus open on hover or ArrowRight. Click outside or Escape closes menu. Supports sync/async onSelect handlers.
behavior.rendering: Always renders primary and toggle buttons. Menu renders if open=true. Menu items render from options array. Submenu renders if item has children and openSubIndex matches.

logic.effect: Calls option.onSelect(), closes menu, returns focus to toggle.
Opens menu, focuses first enabled item.
Closes menu, returns focus to toggle.
Focus trapped, cycles through enabled items.

feedback.hover: Menu item hover shows submenu (if children).
feedback.disabled: Disabled items not focusable, grayed out.

states.open: Menu visible, positioned with collision detection.
states.submenuOpen: Nested submenu visible for item with children.

layout: Primary and toggle buttons share variant styling.
Menu positioned with collision detection (viewport margins).
content: Option with children cannot have onSelect.
nesting: Can be nested in forms, toolbars.

accessibility.keyboard: Arrow keys navigate, Tab trapped, Enter/Space select, Escape closes.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus ring on menu items.

responsiveness.rules: Collision detection ensures menu visible on small screens. Menu repositions to fit viewport.

usageNotes: Inherits Button variant, size, surface, rounded, tooltip props.
Menu alignment: start (right) or end (left), auto-adjusted via collision detection.
Viewport margins: 12px buffer from screen edges (industry standard).
Gutter: 8px space between trigger and menu.
Focus management: Arrow keys, Tab (trapped), Home, End, Escape.
Nested menus: open on hover or ArrowRight, close on ArrowLeft.
onSelect supports sync and async handlers (async wrapped in try/catch).
usePortal prevents clipping by overflow:hidden containers.
Toggle label defaults to i18n splitButton.moreOptions.
Menu items use tabIndex=-1 except focused item (tabIndex=0).
Disabled items skipped by findNextEnabled navigation helper.
useLayoutEffect measures menu after render for collision detection.
requestAnimationFrame ensures menu DOM ready before measurement.
React.forwardRef for ref forwarding to wrapper div.
SplitButton icon rendered with Icon component (caret-down).
Menu items can have icon, label, description, trailingIcon, title (tooltip).
